Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. South Africa players stride out to the middle. Followed by Avishka Fernando and Dinesh Chandimal who will open for Sri Lanka. Bjorn Fortuin to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. It has been an engrossing first innings. Sri Lankan bowlers did their job really well. Now, the onus will be on the batters to chase down the target of 164 runs. Can they take an early lead in this T20I series? To find out, do join us for the chase on the other side.

Sri Lankan bowlers could not find much purchase off the pitch! The bowlers were taken for a ride straightaway. There was a chance of sending back Qdk early on, but Dasun Shanaka could not risk taking a review on consecutive deliveries and lost an opportunity to get rid of de Kock early on. But then, it was Wanindu Hasaranga who rose to the occasion and got rid of the opening pair of South Africa in quick succession to get his team right back in the game. The young spinner, Maheesh Theekshana also got a wicket to his name. As it was mentioned it was really a good pitch for batting and Sri Lanka had a phase in the game, where they could not stem up the run flow. Sri Lankan pacers gave away only 16 runs in the final two overs of the innings with two wickets as well, which did not let South Africa reach the 170-run mark.

A flourish start by the openers of Proteas! Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks built a solid foundation at the start. Both the players were on the attack from the word go. De Kock got lucky early on, when the Islanders went against taking a review, when he had got his outside edge into play. But he could not maximise on this lifeline. The opening pair was sent back in quick succession. Heinrich Klaasen and Aiden Markram were the new batters in the middle. The latter settled in well, but the former was sent back on 2 runs. It was then a beautifully stitched partnership between Aiden Markram and David Miller of 65 runs, which took South Africa above the 150-run mark. But even this pair was broken in the final two overs of the innings and South Africa ended their innings at 163/5.

A good batting show put on by South Africa. They were clearly on top in the opening phase of the game. The Sri Lankan spinners got their side back into the game by picking up wickets in quick succession. But the Saffas fought back to not lose their grip over the advantage. It was an end-to-end game, as Sri Lanka came back stronger with two tight overs in the end.
FOUR! Boundary to end the innings, South Africa end at 163 for 5. Chameera pitches it up, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius drags it across the line and towards square leg for a boundary.
A full ball, on off. Dwaine Pretorius heaves it to deep mid-wicket and runs across for a couple of runs.
A slower length ball, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius swings across the line and fails to connect it.
WIDE! Full and way outside off. Wided.
Kagiso Rabada is the man to walk in now.

OUT! An important wicket for Sri Lanka at this stage as Miller could have made a difference. A short ball, on middle. Miller tries to pull but gets a top edge towards square leg where Avishka Fernando takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Avishka Fernando b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Full-length ball, outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
A wide yorker-length ball. Dwaine Pretorius jams it out to sweeper cover for two.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack to bowl the final over.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single. Good penultimate over from Dasun Shanaka.
Who will walk out next? Dwaine Pretorius it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is a brilliant comeback from the captain. Markram makes room on the off side, Shanaka sees it and serves it slow and outside off, on a length. Markram had to reach for it and ends up edging it towards short third man, where Dushmantha Chameera takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dushmantha Chameera b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Full and angling on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for two.
A slower yorker-length ball, on middle. Markram makes room and waits for the ball. Ends up jamming it out back to the bowler.

A pacy short ball, on off. Markram gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The square leg fielder runs across and cuts it off in the end. They take two. This also brings up 150 for South Africa.
Full and on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Dasun Shanaka comes into the attack. He replaces Dushmantha Chameera.
On the pads. Miller looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge towards point for a single. Big over for South Africa, 17 coming of it.
On a length, on off, worked on the off side for a single.

SIX! High and Handsome! A full ball, outside off, a slower ball. Markram gets across and smashes it straight down the ground towards long off for a biggie. It was a slower ball so he had to generate all the pace.
FOUR! 50 up between these two! A full ball, outside off. Markram goes for the reverse sweep and plays it nice and fine over short third man for a boundary.
Another slower delivery, on middle, pulled away to square leg for one.
Good running between the wickets! A slower full ball, outside off. Markram lofts it to the wide of long off. The cover fielder runs across and cuts it off. Three taken.
WIDE! Starts with a full ball and way outside off. Left alone.
Chamika Karunaratne comes back into the attack.
A full ball, outside off. Miller smashes it hard and to the left of deep point. The fielder in the deep runs to that side and does well to save a couple of runs.

FOUR! EDGY RUNS! Chameera comes around the wicket and serves a full toss, outside off. Miller looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past the diving keeper and the ball races away to the third man fence.
FOUR! Good shot! On a length, on middle, another slower ball. Miller waits for the ball and pulls it nicely through square leg for a boundary.
Serves a full toss, on the leg. Markram makes room and pushes it to covers for another single.
A slower length ball, on middle. Miller looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge to mid off and they collect a single.
On a length, on off. Markram chips it uppishly to mid off and scampers through for a quick single.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack now.
Full and on off, eased down to long on for one more.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one.
SIX! BANG! A full ball, outside off. Miller reaches to it and fetches this one straight down the ground for a biggie.
Slightly shorter, on off. Markram drills it down to long off for a single.
Nicely bowled! This one lands on middle and turns away sharply. Markram is beaten as he looks to defend.
Full and on middle, pushed on the leg side for a single.
SIX! Clean hit! Floated full and on off. Markram gets low and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. 13 runs coming off the over. A good one for South Africa.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Markram looks to sweep it away but misses. The keeper moves to his left to make a good stop. Wide called.
Loopy ball, around off. Miller hangs back and flicks it across the line to mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off. Markram skips down the track and drills it to long on for another single. These two batters are making sure that they keep the runs ticking.
Floated, around middle and leg. Miller tucks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full and on off. Markram goes back and flicks it to leg side for just a run this time.
Darted, on the pads. Markram skips down the track and flicks it awkwardly through mid-wicket for a couple.
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Good slower ball to end the over. Chamika Karunaratne serves it full and on off. Markram pushes it to point and takes off for a single.
On a length, around off. Markram hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple. Good running.
EDGY! A length ball, around off. Miller looks to flick it away. The ball takes the leading edge and goes to the left of point. The ball lands safely in the gap. They take one.
A length ball, on the pads. Markram hangs back and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for another run.
A slower, full toss. Around off. Miller stays back and guides it towards point for a single. Miller is off the mark with a single.
A full-length ball, on middle. Aiden Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
David Miller walks out.

OUT! LBW! Three wickets in quick succession and Sri Lanka are right in this game. Their spinners are doing an incredible job to pull things back. A tossed up ball, full and on middle, it lands and spins away. Klaasen gets on his knee and looks to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the back pad. They appeal and up goes the finger. Klaasen straightaway reviews it. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball tracker shows impact is umpire's call and wickets is also umpire's call. So, the on-field decision stays.

Review time! Heinrich Klaasen takes it upstairs for an LBW decision. The on-field decision is out. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows it is umpire's call on impact and the ball hitting the wickets. The on-field decision stands. South Africa retain their review here but Heinrich Klaasen has to walk back to the dressing room.
A short ball, outside off. Markram cuts it late to backward point where the fielder does well to dive to his left and stop it. A single taken.
Full and on middle, swept away to square leg for a single.
This one lands on off and spins away, Klaasen is beaten by spin as he looks to defend.
Slight shorter, outside off. Markram rocks back and pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter ball, on off, Aiden Markram slaps it to covers.
Full and on off. Markram punches it through mid on for a single.
On the pads. Klaasen stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for another run.
Floated and on off. Markram works it to long on for a single.
Full and on off. Markram pushes it to cover but straight to the fielder.
Floated full and on off. Aiden Markram pushes it to point for a couple.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka are back in the game. Wanindu Hasaranga gets his second wicket and also gets rid of another set batsman, Reeza Hendricks. He serves a floated ball, full and around middle. Reeza Hendricks gets low and looks to sweep it away. He only manages to get a top edge on it. The ball goes towards short fine leg. Maheesh Theekshana settles under it and takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the pads. Reeza Hendricks tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short and outside off. Markram punches it through cover for a single.
Full and on middle. Aiden Markram works it through square leg for a single.
That's a lot of turn. Loopy ball, around off. The ball turns in a long way. Markram goes back and looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Down leg.
Darted on the pads. Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Floated full and on off. Aiden Markram plays it back to the bowler.
Full and on leg. Reeza Hendricks lookt to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Wanindu Hasaranga puts in half an appeal but does not prolong it.
Aiden Markram walks out at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wanindu Hasaranga draws first blood and it is a big wicket of Quinton de Kock. Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock gets low and looks to go for the slog sweep. He does so, but does not connect well. Infact, he gets a top edge on that one. The ball flies high in the air and goes towards deep mid-wicket. Charith Asalanka settles under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Charith Asalanka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and on off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and pushes it to mid on for a single.
Loopy ball, down leg. Quinton de Kock works it to fine leg for another single.
Slightly short and outside off. Reeza Hendricks taps it to point for a single.
Full and on off. Quinton de Kock works it towards mid on for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga to continue.
On the pads. Reeza Hendricks clips it to mid-wicket for a brace. 11 runs off the over.
Full and on off. Quinton de Kock looks to reverse sweep again but does not connect well this time. The ball out to the off side of the pitch. The batters take a quick single.
Floated and on off. Quinton de Kock reverse sweeps it through square leg. The batters pick up a couple before the fielder cuts it out.
Short and on off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it to cover for a single.
FOUR! into the gap. Looped up, full and on off. Quinton de Kock whips it across the line. The ball goes through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floated it up, on middle. Quinton de Kock tucks it on the leg side for a single. Good start from Wanindu Hasaranga. Only 4 singles from it.
Tossed up, on middle. Reeza Hendricks sweeps it towards deep square leg. He crosses ends.
Full again, on off. Quinton de Kock steps out and nudges it to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Quinton de Kock defends it towards covers.
A googly on middle, Reeza Hendricks rocks back and plays it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, on off. Reeza Hendricks blocks it out off the back foot.
Full and outside off, Quinton de Kock reverse-sweeps it but straight to point.

Edged but did not carry! Loopy ball, on off, turning away. Quinton de Kock looks to flick but miscues. The ball goes off the outside edge and goes past the keeper's gloves. Akila Dananjaya gives it a chase and cuts it off. Two taken.
A carrom ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it through covers for a single.
Full and on middle and leg, Quinton de Kock clips it to mid-wicket for just a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Reeza Hendricks works it with spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated it up, outside off. Reeza Hendricks cuts it past point for a brace.
Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack. His figures read 1-0-14-0 so far.
Short of a length again, on off. Reeza Hendricks punches it towards covers for a single. End of the Powerplay, South Africa are 47/0.
Short of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock guides it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle, 141 kph. Quinton de Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! No stopping that! Slower ball bouncer, on middle. Quinton de Kock stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good-length ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks pushes it towards mid off. He sets off for a quick single. Dasun Shanaka has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good-length ball on off, Reeza Hendricks does well to block it out.
Dushmantha Chameera is back into the attack. His figures read 1-0-5-0 so far. He replaces Dhananjaya de Silva.
Full and on off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it to cover for a single.
Tossed up, around off. the ball turns in. Reeza Hendricks stays back and looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Going down leg.
Floated, full and around middle. Quinton de Kock makes room and punches it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Hendricks works it towards long on for a single.
SIX! Full toss and punished! Akila Dananjaya serves a full toss and on off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full and on off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it to cover.
Looped up, around off. Quinton de Kock prods and looks to sweep it out. The ball takes the inside edge onto the pads. Dhananjaya de Silva puts in half an appeal but does not pursue it.
SIX! BOOM! Floated, around middle and leg. Quinton de Kock makes room and whips it across the line. The ball goes over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full and on the pads. Reeza Hendricks tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off. Quinton de Kock looks to work it over but only manages to get an outside edge. The ball goes towards the man at backward point. The batters take one.
Floated and around off. Quinton de Kock taps it to point.
Flighted full and outside off. Quinton de Kock stays back and pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! A juicy full toss, outside off. Reeza Hendricks drives it through extra cover for a boundary. Good over for South Africa. 14 runs from it.
FOUR! Two in a row! Floated it up, outside off. Reeza Hendricks once again rocks back, opens the face of the bat and cuts it past point for another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Short and outside off, Reeza Hendricks rocks back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
In the air, but safe! Tossed up, on middle. Quinton de Kock clears his front leg and chips it towards long off. The fielder charges ahead to catch the ball but it falls short of him. A single.
Full and outside off, Quinton de Kock looks to reverse sweep but fails to get any bat on it.
Loopy ball on middle, worked to long on for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana is brought into the attack.
Floated it up, on off. Reeza Hendricks chips it towards long on. He retains the strike by picking up a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and punches it towards covers.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Quinton de Kock tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Floated it up, on off. Reeza Hendricks works it to mid on for one.
Loopy ball, outside off, turning in. Reeza Hendricks looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock taps it towards point for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl from the other end.
A length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it to cover for a single.

A full-length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to chase it but misses. Chameera appeals for caught behind but the umpire is not interested. This time Dasun Shanaka does not go for the review. Later the replays rolled in to show us that there was bat involved and the decision could've been turned around if the Islanders had taken the review for caught behind.
Sri Lanka have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking show that the ball is pitching outside leg. Sri Lanka lose their review.

NOT OUT! Quinton de Kock survives a review call here. A length ball, around middle and off. Quinton de Kock hangs back and looks to whip it across the line but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Chameera puts in an appeal but the umpire says no. Dasun Shanaka decides to take it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows the ball is pitching outside leg. The final decision is not out.

Quinton de Kock tries to be innovative this time, could've ended up being a costly one. A length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock moves across and looks to paddle scoop it over the keeper's head. The ball clips the pads, scoots past the off stump and goes to the keeper.

FOUR! He is up and going. Quinton de Kock is off the mark with a boundary. A full-length ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock stays back and whips it through square leg. The ball races away to the boundary.
Chameera starts with a full-length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock hangs back and pushes it to the right of mid off. The fielder there moves to his right to make the stop.

We are set for the action to begin. Both the teams are out in the middle for the national anthems. It will be the South African anthem first. Followed by the one of the hosts, Sri Lanka. The South African opening pair of Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks comes out to bat. Followed by the Sri Lankan players who walk out to the middle and spread out to their respective fielding positions. Dushmantha Chameera to start with the ball.

PITCH REPORT – Farveez Maharoof is up for a chat to tell us about the pitch. He says the pitch looks very solid. It looks a very good pitch for batting. He hopes that a lot of runs can be scored on this pitch. Adds that it will be a good day of cricket.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, is up for a chat. He says, they would have batted first as well, but it should be a good toss to lose. Mentions this will be a good platform to prepare for the World Cup. Mentions they have a couple of changes to their side.

Keshav Maharaj, the South African skipper, is up for a chat. He says, they will bat first. Adds they will try to utilise the dew at night. Mentions they will hope to add runs on the scoreboard. Adds they are trying different combinations, they have gone with 5 batters and 4 all-rounders.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Akila Dananjaya.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Keshav Maharaj (C), Kagiso Rabada, Bjorn Fortuin, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in favour of South Africa. They have opted to BAT first.

Hello and a warm welcome to all! It is time for the first of three T20I match between Sri Lanka and South Africa. The Islanders won the ODI series by 2-1 and have jumped to the 5th spot in the World Cup Super League standings. This was also the first ODI series win for Sri Lanka since February 2020. Surely, the momentum will be on their side, and they would hope to start this series on a positive note. The Proteas don’t have enough time to lick their wounds. They will come into this series looking for an avenge. Both the teams would look to sharpen their skills with the T20 World Cup around the corner. Who will come out on top? Let us find out, as the toss is not far away.
